answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond before it can trade, with the bond released only after a probation window of honest work. A newcomer starts on the knoll of the network, visible but with tiny limits, and earns trust slowly, like an ember growing only if fed real, verifiable service. Gossip travels by whisper between peers, so a fake identity that misbehaves is flagged everywhere at once. An attacker must fund a bond and burn weeks of effort for each fake, so mass sybils cost more than they can ever earn back.
